pages.text: Every Create network needs at least one source of rotation. They differ in how much capacity they give, how fast they spin, and how much setup they take.

pages.title: Hand Crank
pages.text: You power it. Hold Use to rotate one way, sneak and hold Use for the other. Useful for testing and tiny jobs.

pages.title: Water Wheel
pages.text: Takes force from adjacent flowing water. Extra sides in water do not add output. Low capacity, steady.

pages.title: Large Water Wheel
pages.text: Spins at half the speed of a normal wheel, but gives a much higher stress capacity.

pages.title: Windmill Bearing
pages.text: Spins a structure of sails. At least 8 sail blocks are needed, and more sails spin it faster. Needs open air and glue to hold the structure.

pages.title: Windmill Sail
pages.text: Place on a sail frame or any block. Right-click with dye to colour, shears turn it back to a frame.

$(bold)Steam Engine.$() Sits on a boiler built from $(item)Fluid Tanks$(). Needs water and heat from a $(item)Blaze Burner$(). A minimal boiler is 4 tanks. Heat more and it reaches a higher power level, and each level lets one more engine run at full strength. Goggles show the level.

pages.title: Steam Engine
pages.text: Connect a shaft to the engine's output. Heat comes from a blaze burner under the boiler. See $(l:create_basics/heat)Heat$(/l) and $(l:create_basics/fluids)Fluids$(/l).

Blaze burners and engines make $(l:survival/pollution)pollution$(/l) in this pack. The Creative Motor exists but is not obtainable in survival.$(br2)Add-ons bring more sources: $(l:industry/electricity)Electricity$(/l) and $(l:industry/liquid_fuel)Liquid Fuel$(/l).
